what: SYNTHETIC. Goals are seeded Poisson draws (club strengths uniform in +-sigma where sigma is given); rows are what the real collector makes from stubbed ESPN payloads. Not real data. The expected values were computed by scripts/uefa-replicate-run.mjs (G3 assumed passed). The frozen part (252 rows) is the pinned frozen 2026-27 bundle with one id per canonical club; the forward part is synthetic. Pooled with the Look 1 fixture b-moderate.

bundle26.what: Completed events of the three main UEFA competitions, read from ESPN scoreboards one day per read. A club is its ESPN team id. No model number is computed here (the rule is outbox/forecast-replicate-uefa-2026-11-28.mjs, fixed first).
